answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 85 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The mesa register is checked at draw time, ledge lists the eligible set, and forge seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 85 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone burns for every seat it wants. A 467 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
